data.description:
## Description

What: New defense-store-to-thread-resolve.sh adapter that polls the defense store once for new entries since the last cursor (cold-start seeds cursor to defense-store HEAD and emits cursor_initialized; historical entries not processed), and for each new entry with defense_type in {dropped_by_arbiter, deferred_to_followup, defended_accepted} that carries a github_comment_id, resolves the matching review thread via a single (non-batched) gh api graphql resolveReviewThread mutation; thread-ID resolution maps comment ID to pullRequest.reviewThreads.nodes[].comments.nodes[].id (cached per PR per session); per-call uses || true with INFO log on 4xx (already-resolved / merged / force-push-orphaned); startup permission probe hard-errors on insufficient scope. Records without github_comment_id are skipped with INFO. The same trigger covers both arbiter rulings (sc-3) and our own llm reviewer's accepted defenses (sc-4). Why: closes both the bot-thread-noise gap and the pre-existing dso-llm accepted-defense gap via one uniform mechanism. Scope IN: the adapter, cursor polling + cold-start, thread-ID resolution + per-PR cache, non-batched mutation with || true, graceful skip on missing field, the mocked-gh auto-resolve test asserting mutation called with correct threadId and that the permission probe runs. Scope OUT: the CI job wiring + permissions block (draft-9); the defense schema field (draft-4).


## Done Definitions

- For each defense-store entry with defense_type in {dropped_by_arbiter, deferred_to_followup, defended_accepted} carrying a github_comment_id, the adapter dispatches a resolveReviewThread GraphQL mutation against the matched threadId within 60 seconds; the mocked-gh test asserts the mutation is called with the correct threadId and the startup permission probe runs ← Satisfies: sc-3
- A defended_accepted entry produced by our own llm reviewer (no arbiter involvement) is auto-resolved by the same trigger, proving the uniform mechanism fixes the pre-existing dso-llm gap ← Satisfies: sc-4
- A defense record without github_comment_id is skipped with an INFO: defense has no github_comment_id; skipping thread resolution log and no mutation is dispatched ← Satisfies: sc-3
- On first run with no cursor, the adapter seeds the cursor to defense-store HEAD, emits a cursor_initialized marker, and processes zero historical entries; on a 4xx mutation response the adapter logs INFO and continues ← Satisfies: sc-3

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Non-batched single-threaded mutations with || true per call; hard-error only on the startup permission probe so misconfiguration is visible while transient 4xx are absorbed.
- [Cold-start] First-deploy cursor seeding to HEAD prevents a burst of resolution attempts against already-merged/deleted PRs.
- [Trigger-surface-reconciliation] Specify which defense store the defense-store-to-thread-resolve.sh adapter polls — TrackerDefenseStore (local) or GitHubPRDefenseStore (CI) — and confirm the producing writer (dso-llm resolver per draft-10, and the b575 arbiter) targets that SAME store for the runtime context where resolution runs. A single-store cursor poll that reads a store no producer writes to in that context means sc-4 never fires in CI. State the store choice per context (local vs CI) explicitly.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an engineer, I want resolved/dropped/deferred/accepted-defense outcomes to auto-resolve the corresponding GitHub conversation thread, so that bot and dso-llm threads stop accumulating unresolved on my PRs.
